cameras.name: overview

channels.name: school_zone_observation
channels.method: same-frame Native velocity and reviewed school-zone station
channels.reference_frame: Native world XY and school-zone road station
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; designation and exceptions require independent authority review

channels.name: dev.zone_sign
channels.method: original approach camera and reviewed installed school-zone sign/schedule source joined by school_zone_context.json
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: drv.within_signed_zone
channels.method: original Native vehicle station compared with reviewed school-zone bounds on the governing road/direction
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: kin.speed
channels.method: original Native velocity vector converted to mph on each original in-zone frame
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: dev.speed_limit_beacon
channels.method: original approach camera and reviewed operational beacon/alternating yellow-light phase source joined by original frame
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: drv.condition_in_effect
channels.method: reviewed school calendar, operating hours, half-hour window, sign schedule and beacon phase joined to frame civil time
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: env.civil_time
channels.method: reviewed timezone-aware civil start plus original video frame time, checked against calendar source
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only

channels.name: ru.motor_vehicle
channels.method: original Native ego blueprint and actor identity joined to independent heavy-vehicle class review
channels.reference_frame: original Native frame and governing school-zone road/direction
channels.uncertainty: Original school authority, vehicle class, sign/beacon state and camera visibility require independent local review; synthetic fixture values prove software only
